## 68a.1 "What is time?" — Al-Khalili's opening retreat

**Anchor.** Under the McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic, time is what our clocks show as they measure the shadow phenomena cast by x₄'s advance at rate c from every spacetime point. Coordinate-time t is the integrated coordinate label of dx₄/dt = ic. This supplies a definition, not a paraphrase.

**Verbatim (Al-Khalili, 0:03:15–0:04:50).** Carroll asks: "let's start with, what is time?" Al-Khalili replies: "It's a tough question because it's one that we've been thinking, we, humanity, has been thinking about for millennia … we may not be that much closer to answering the ultimate question." Pressed for a direct answer: "For me, time is a real thing. It's tangible. It's part of four-dimensional spacetime, the fabric of our existence, of reality itself. It's not just that thing that clocks measure. It's a real thing. It exists."

**Criterion Al-Khalili itemizes:** (i) time is a real physical entity; (ii) it is more than what clocks measure; (iii) it is part of four-dimensional spacetime.

**McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic reading.** Points (i)–(iii) are satisfied by the Principle in the exact form Al-Khalili asks for. The physical entity is x₄, expanding at rate c from every spacetime point. Clocks measure the integrated projection of this expansion onto the observer's worldline; this is why "time is what clocks measure" is right but incomplete — clocks measure the shadow, not the source. The four-dimensional character of spacetime is derived (Theorem 6.4 of §10.6, four-velocity budget u^μ u_μ = −c²), not postulated. ## 68b.13a Brukner 2018 no-go and Frauchiger–Renner 2018 — the framework's four-way disposition

**McGucken Principle anchor.** Under dx₄/dt = ic, the four-dimensional McGucken Sphere Σ₊(p_E) from any source event p_E is one physical object, undivided in x₄, with its cross-sections at different spatial slices being partial readings of that one object (Theorem 10.1 of §14.2). Two entangled systems created at a common event share the x₄-coordinate of that event and remain x₄-coincident as the expansion carries them outward (Theorem 28.4 of §38a.1). Brukner's 2018 no-go theorem and the Frauchiger–Renner 2018 self-consistency argument both constrain any framework asserting observer-independent measurement facts; the McGucken dx₄/dt = ic framework's disposition against both is stated here.

**Brukner 2018.** Brukner proves [Brukner 2018, *Nature Physics* 14, 322] that four assumptions are jointly incompatible: (1) universal validity of quantum theory (it applies at every scale, including an observer and her laboratory); (2) locality (one observer's setting choice does not influence a distant observer's outcome); (3) freedom of choice (settings are statistically independent of the rest of the experiment); (4) observer-independent facts (the outcomes of Wigner and of his friend can be assigned joint truth values in a single Boolean algebra). The CHSH test on a nested Wigner-friend arrangement reaches S = 2√2, above the bound of 2 that assumption (4) requires. At least one assumption must be relinquished.

**The McGucken dx₄/dt = ic framework's disposition.** The framework's derivational commitments fix which assumption is given up. (1) is retained — dx₄/dt = ic applies at every scale, with no collapse threshold (Theorem 5.1 of §7.4a; contrast with objective-collapse models, which relinquish (1)). (3) is retained — the framework is not superdeterministic. (4) is retained — the measurement outcome is a physical first-contact collision event at a definite spacetime point (Theorem 10.13 of §14.10), a Geometric Channel event with definite coordinates that occurs whether or not it is observed. The assumption relinquished is (2), locality, and it is relinquished with a physical mechanism — the x₄-coincidence of the outbound expansion (Theorem 28.4 of §38a.1). A setting choice on one wing is a measurement performed on one 3-spatial cross-section of a single object undivided in x₄ — no spacelike influence transmitted between separate systems is required, because there is no separation in x₄. The framework is in Brukner's classification nonlocal — in the same category as de Broglie–Bohm, which Brukner names as relinquishing (2) — but the nonlocality is the x₄-coincidence of the outbound expansion of one physical object, not action across a spatial gap between separate objects. The S = 2√2 that Brukner derives is the Tsirelson value the framework independently derives as the maximum SO(3)-Haar-weighted correlation on the spherically symmetric expansion (Theorem 28.5a of §38a.4 and [2, Theorem 13]) — the framework's own prediction, not a tension within it.

**Cost of relinquishing locality — the Cloaking Theorem 39 pays it.** A nonlocal theory sits in apparent tension with the no-preferred-frame content of special relativity. The framework's answer is Theorem 39 of the corpus [24, imported at Theorem 41 of §51.6 of the present paper]: the preferred x₄-foliation to which the coincidence is referred (the CMB rest frame of Theorem 40 of §51) is locally undetectable, its bookkeeping quantities cancelling from every local invariant measurement any observer performs, so the nonlocality carries no signal (Theorem 28.11 of §38a.10, exact no-signaling) and produces no operational conflict with local Lorentz invariance. This is the same foliation-relative commitment that the four-velocity bookkeeping quantities carry (Appendix A on the four x₄-rate quantities): real, referred to the cosmic-comoving frame, and cloaked from local metrology. The apparent tension between nonlocality and Lorentz invariance is dissolved at the derivational level.

**Frauchiger–Renner 2018.** The Frauchiger–Renner extension [Frauchiger–Renner 2018, *Nature Communications* 9, 3711] sharpens Brukner's result: no theory can jointly satisfy compliance with quantum theory (QT), single-world (SW), and self-consistency (SC). The McGucken dx₄/dt = ic framework is single-world — one the Geometric Channel first-contact collision per measurement event, no Everett branches — so it retains (SW) and the argument applies to it. The framework's route to consistency is the cross-section structure of Theorem 10.1 of §14.2: the nested statements of F₁, F₂, A, and W are readings of one x₄-extended state, and their consistency is enforced by x₄-coincidence rather than by comparing truth values across the mutually incompatible measurement contexts whose comparison the Frauchiger–Renner argument requires. The framework's diagnosis coincides with Brukner's own reading of Frauchiger–Renner: the self-consistency property (SC) illegitimately promotes one observer's knowledge of another observer's context-bound outcome into a joint Boolean algebra, and the promotion fails precisely because the outcomes live on different cross-sections of the x₄-extended state. The physical referent for that failure is the cross-sections being 3-spatial slices of one four-dimensional object, not competing accounts requiring reconciliation in a single context.

**Summary of the four-way disposition.**

| Brukner assumption | McGucken dx₄/dt = ic disposition | Derivational anchor |
|---|---|---|
| (1) Universal validity of QM | retained (no collapse threshold) | Theorem 5.1 of §7.4a; Theorem 10.5d of §10.11 |
| (2) Locality | relinquished with physical mechanism (x₄-coincidence) | Theorem 28.4 of §38a.1 (First Law of Nonlocality); Theorem 28.10 of §38a.9 |
| (3) Freedom of choice | retained (not superdeterministic) | — |
| (4) Observer-independent facts | retained (collision event has definite coordinates) | Theorem 10.13 of §14.10; Theorem 10.1 of §14.2 (cross-section reading) |

Al-Khalili's dilemma of §68b.13 above is closed on the strength of this four-way disposition: the framework holds (1)(3)(4) and gives up (2), with the giving-up carrying the physical mechanism of x₄-coincidence — one Sphere with the preferred foliation cloaked by Theorem 39, no bare posit required.

## 64.5 The Two-Tier Architecture and the Signature-Pairing of the Arrows

The deepest derivational finding of the present paper, beyond the dissolution of the twelve canonical problems of time, is the *Two-Tier Architecture* of Theorem 10.5 (§14.7) combined with the *Wick-rotation signature-pairing* of Theorem 10.4 (§14.6) and Theorem 6.4 (§10.6). These three theorems together establish a derivational picture of time and its arrows that the standard literature has not been positioned to articulate.

The picture is the following. Time and its arrows are not five (or twelve) independent phenomena requiring separate explanations. They live in exactly three derivational tiers, all sourced by one principle:

- *Tier 0 — the foundational principle: dx₄/dt = ic.* One physical-geometric statement: the fourth dimension is expanding at the velocity of light in a spherically symmetric manner from every event of spacetime. This is the unique source of every arrow content.

- *Tier 1 — matter-dynamics arrows on the McGucken manifold.* The arrows associated with the behavior of matter on a (locally fixed, or perturbatively small) McGucken-manifold background. Tier 1 admits a Wick-rotation signature-pair structure: the thermodynamic arrow (Euclidean signature: strict monotonicity dS/dt = (3/2)k_B/t > 0; Compton-coupling Brownian dissolution; Theorem 6) and the quantum-measurement arrow (Lorentzian signature: unitary U(x₄); measurement projection $\hat P_{a}$; conditioning asymmetry; Theorem 10) are not two distinct arrows but *one arrow in two signatures* (Theorem 10.4), bridged by the McGucken-Wick rotation τ_E = x₄/c. Subordinate to Tier 1 are the radiative arrow (Theorem 8: the Geometric Channel's spherical-isotropy of secondary wavelet propagation), the psychological/biological arrow (Theorem 9: the biological and cognitive projection of the thermodynamic and radiative content), and the additional subordinates of §15.

- *Tier 2 — the metric-dynamics arrow.* The arrow associated with the global behavior of the McGucken manifold itself, the cosmological expansion of the spatial 3-manifold Σ_t with strictly positive Hubble parameter H(t) > 0 (Theorem 7). The cosmological arrow lives at a different derivational tier than the matter-dynamics arrows because it is an arrow of the metric, not of matter on the metric.

The Two-Tier Architecture has three derivational payoffs that the standard literature should record carefully.

*First*, it resolves a long-standing puzzle about the agreement of the thermodynamic and quantum-measurement arrows. Penrose 1989 noted this agreement as one of the deepest mysteries of physics; Carroll 2010 surveyed the literature without finding a derivational source for the agreement; the standard responses (decoherence, environmental coupling, entanglement with the apparatus) recover the fact of agreement but not its necessity. The Two-Tier Architecture supplies the necessity: the two arrows agree because they are the same arrow in two signatures. There is one +ic of x₄'s advance at Tier 0; the matter-dynamics arrows at Tier 1 are the two signature-readings of that +ic acting on matter.

*Second*, it resolves the derivational relationship between the cosmological arrow and the matter-dynamics arrows. The standard tradition — Penrose 1989 most explicitly — has tried to derive the matter-dynamics arrows *from* the cosmological arrow via the Past Hypothesis: the low-entropy initial state of the universe is read as the derivational source of all subsequent matter-asymmetry. This is the wrong direction. The cosmological arrow and the matter-dynamics arrows are not in a derivation chain (one from the other); they are differently-tiered consequences of one principle. The cosmological arrow is sourced by the same +ic that sources the matter-dynamics arrows; the Past Hypothesis is dissolved at the principle level (Theorem 14) rather than serving as the source of asymmetry. The matter-dynamics arrows do not derive from the cosmological arrow; both derive from dx₄/dt = ic.

*Third*, it places the derivational relationship between quantum mechanics and classical statistical mechanics at the right tier of foundational physics. The Kac–Nelson correspondence (Kac 1949, Nelson 1964) — the seventy-five-year-old empirical fact that constructive Euclidean QFT computations and Lorentzian QFT predictions agree under the substitution t = −iτ_E — has been used as a calculational tool whose mathematical equivalence is documented but whose physical source has remained obscure. The Two-Tier Architecture supplies the physical source: at Tier 1 of the McGucken-framework structure, the Lorentzian-signature reading of matter dynamics is quantum mechanics and the Euclidean-signature reading is classical statistical mechanics, with the two related by the McGucken-Wick rotation τ_E = x₄/c that is the McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic written in different units. The Kac–Nelson substitution works because τ_E and t are two coordinatizations of the same physical x₄-axis.

The Two-Tier Architecture is therefore the derivational unification of the *philosophy of time* (which has historically asked whether the apparent passage of time is real and which arrow is fundamental) with the *physics of time* (which has historically asked why the thermodynamic and quantum-measurement arrows agree and how to reconcile Schrödinger unitarity with entropic irreversibility). Both lineages are resolved by Theorem 10.5: the apparent passage of time is real and is the +ic advance of x₄ at Tier 0; the matter-dynamics arrows agree because they are signature-pair at Tier 1; the cosmological arrow lives at Tier 2 as the metric's own arrow; and the Schrödinger-unitarity / entropic-irreversibility "tension" dissolves because what is preserved in Lorentzian signature and what is destroyed in Euclidean signature are the same content read on two notations of one axis.

We import the result as Theorem 43 of the present paper.

## 70.1 The Dual-Channel Architecture in Full: 47 Theorems, Two Routes Each

The McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic — the physical, geometric fact that the fourth dimension is expanding at the velocity of light in a spherically symmetric manner from every spacetime event — generates *two derivationally disjoint* derivational chains to the same body of foundational physics. [4] establishes this through forty-seven numbered theorems, each derived twice: once through the dx₄/dt = ic Algebraic Channel (algebraic-symmetry, Lorentzian-signature; Stone–Noether–Lovelock machinery) and once through the dx₄/dt = ic Geometric Channel (geometric-propagation, Euclidean-signature; iterated-McGucken-Sphere–Huygens–Jacobson machinery), with the two derivations sharing *no* intermediate mathematical machinery.

**General Relativity (24 theorems, GR T1–T24).** Both channels derive:

*Foundations (GR T1–T7).* The Master Equation u^μ u_μ = -c² (GR T1); the McGucken-Invariance Lemma ∂ g_μν/∂(dx₄/dt) = 0 (GR T2); the Weak (GR T3), Einstein (GR T4), and Strong (GR T5) Equivalence Principles; the Massless-Lightspeed Equivalence (GR T6); the Geodesic Principle (GR T7).

Both are projections of dx₄/dt = ic onto their respective sectors. The constant c enters u^μ u_μ = -c² as the rate of x₄-expansion; the constant ℏ enters $[\hat q, \hat p] = i\hbar$ as the action quantum per Compton-frequency cycle. ## 70.2 The Empirical-Confirmation Theorem

**Theorem 43 (Bayesian Empirical Confirmation of dx₄/dt = ic via the Dual-Channel Architecture, Grade 3; consolidates [4, §IX.6, Proposition 140, Proposition 141, Theorem 143, Corollary 145, Remark 146, Proposition 147]; rests on the seventy-five GR + QM theorems of [4, Parts II–V] and the Derivational-Disjointness Theorem [4, Theorem 125] verified for five cornerstone pairs in Part VII of [4]).** *Let H denote the McGucken Principle hypothesis ("dx₄/dt = ic describes the actual dynamics of a real fourth spatial dimension expanding at velocity c spherically symmetrically from every event") and $\bar H$ its negation ("dx₄/dt = ic is at most a useful formal device with no underlying dynamical reality"). Let E denote the body of evidence assembled in [4, Parts II–V] and the empirical-observations catalogue: that dx₄/dt = ic derives all 47 numbered theorems of foundational gravity and quantum mechanics through the Algebraic Channel and through the Geometric Channel, with the two derivation chains derivationally disjoint and the 47 theorems' empirical predictions matching measured values within experimental error. Then under conservative benchmarks deliberately favoring $\bar H$:*

$$\frac{P(E \mid H)}{P(E \mid \bar H)} \gtrsim 10^{141}, \qquad \log_{10}\!\frac{P(E \mid H)}{P(E \mid \bar H)} \gtrsim 141.$$

*Under stricter (and equally defensible) benchmarks reflecting the multi-significant-figure precision of the 47 predictions, the figure increases to log₁₀(ratio) ≳ 420. The qualitative content — decisive Bayesian support for the physical reality of dx₄/dt = ic — is independent of the specific benchmark within any defensible range, and the figure 10¹⁴¹ is consistently a conservative lower bound, not an upper estimate.*

**Proof.** Imported from [4, §IX.6, Theorem 143]. Three propositions establish the result.

*Proposition 1 (Likelihood under H).* If H holds — if dx₄/dt = ic is the actual dynamical principle governing the fourth dimension — then the 47 derivations of [4, Parts II–V] are the mathematical consequences of the physical fact. The Algebraic Channel chain is the algebraic-symmetry consequence; the Geometric Channel chain is the geometric-propagation consequence; the derivational disjointness of the two chains is the consequence of dx₄/dt = ic admitting both an interior reading of i (the Algebraic Channel) and an exterior reading via τ_E = x₄/c (the Geometric Channel, McGucken-Wick rotation of Theorem 6.5a). The empirical predictions matching measurement is the consequence of the derivations being correct. Under H, the entire body E is the expected outcome up to derivational labour. Hence $P(E \mid H) \approx 1$.

*Proposition 2 (Decomposition of E under $\bar H$).* Under $\bar H$, the joint observation E decomposes into three derivationally independent sub-observations:

- E_A: the Algebraic Channel derives all 47 theorems from dx₄/dt = ic as a formal device.
- E_B: the Geometric Channel derives all 47 theorems from dx₄/dt = ic as a formal device.
- E_disj: The two chains are derivationally disjoint (no shared intermediate machinery, per [4, Definition 118] verified for the five cornerstone pairs in [4, Part VII]).

By the derivational-disjointness commitment, the probability of E_B conditional on E_A under $\bar H$ is approximately equal to the unconditional probability of E_B under $\bar H$: the two chains share no intermediate machinery, so under $\bar H$ — where the dual-channel success would be a coincidence not forced by any underlying physical reality — the success of one chain at producing the 47 equations is derivationally uninformative about the success of the other. Hence $P(E \mid \bar H) \approx P(E_A \mid \bar H) \cdot P(E_B \mid \bar H) \cdot P(E_{\text{disj}} \mid \bar H)$.

Estimating each factor under conservative benchmarks: a reasonable benchmark probability that an arbitrary physically-motivated four-dimensional postulate produces a given numbered foundational equation correctly through a derivationally rigorous chain is p₀ ∼ 0.1 per equation. Under this benchmark, $P(E_A \mid \bar H) \sim p_0^{47} \sim 10^{-47}$ and identically $P(E_B \mid \bar H) \sim 10^{-47}$. The benchmark p₀ = 10^-1 is generous to $\bar H$: many of the 47 theorems involve numerical constants with multiple significant figures matching measurement (Mercury's 43"/century, Eddington's 1.75", Tsirelson's 2√(2), Hawking's T_H = ℏ c³/(8π G M k_B) with the factor 1/(8π), the Bekenstein–Hawking factor 1/4, the Born rule's |ψ|² rather than |ψ| or |ψ|³); each of these would, under a less-generous benchmark, count as p₀ ∼ 10^-3 or smaller.

For $P(E_{\text{disj}} \mid \bar H)$: under $\bar H$, a single formal device producing two derivationally disjoint chains to the same 47 equations requires that they share no intermediate machinery despite hitting the same conclusions — a strong constraint given the limited universe of named structures in foundational physics. A conservative benchmark of p_disj ∼ 10^-1 per theorem-pair gives $P(E_{\text{disj}} \mid \bar H) \sim 10^{-47}$.

*Proposition 3 (Combination).* By Propositions 1–2,
$$\frac{P(E \mid H)}{P(E \mid \bar H)} \approx \frac{1}{P(E_A \mid \bar H) \cdot P(E_B \mid \bar H) \cdot P(E_{\text{disj}} \mid \bar H)} \gtrsim \frac{1}{10^{-47} \cdot 10^{-47} \cdot 10^{-47}} = 10^{141}.$$

The posterior odds in favor of H exceed the prior odds by a factor of at least 10¹⁴¹. ∎

## 70.3 Comparison with Standard Foundational-Physics Evidence

**Corollary 43.1 (Posterior Odds; consolidates [4, Corollary 145]).** *For any prior odds $P(H)/P(\bar H)$ not themselves smaller than 10^-141 — which is to say, for any prior that does not assign astronomical pre-evidential confidence to $\bar H$ — the posterior odds favor H.*

The likelihood ratio of 10¹⁴¹ is exceptional even by the standards of foundational-physics evidence. On Jeffreys' (1961) classification, log₁₀(ratio) > 1.5 is "very strong" evidence and log₁₀(ratio) > 2 is "decisive." On the Kass–Raftery (1995) refinement, log₁₀(ratio) > 2 is "decisive." The dual-channel architecture's log₁₀(ratio) ≳ 141 is more than seventy times the threshold of the strongest standard category. Comparable likelihood ratios in physics include:

- **Higgs-boson discovery at 5σ** (log₁₀ ∼ 6). The McGucken dual-channel architecture's log₁₀ ∼ 141 exceeds this by a factor of ∼ 23.
- **Cosmological dark-matter inference from CMB** (log₁₀ ∼ 100, depending on alternative-model specification). The McGucken figure exceeds this by a factor of ∼ 1.4 on conservative benchmark, by ∼ 4 on the stricter log₁₀ ≳ 420 benchmark.

The dual-channel architecture's evidential weight on the conservative benchmark exceeds *both* of these standards of decisive empirical confirmation.

## 70.4 Prediction, Not Postdiction

**Proposition 43.2 (The McGucken Principle as Prediction; consolidates [4, Proposition 147]).** *The McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic is a genuinely predictive hypothesis, in the strict sense that it has existed as a foundational postulate in the published record since the late 1990s (McGucken, UNC Chapel Hill dissertation appendix, 1998–99; [55]) and that the dual-channel derivations of [4, Parts II–V] forced their conclusions through derivationally rigorous chains rather than through curve-fitting.*

Three derivational features distinguish the McGucken architecture from postdictive fitting:

*(i) Priority of the postulate.* The principle dx₄/dt = ic appeared in [55] (1998–99), in the MDT papers (2003–06), in FQXi essays (2008–13), in books (2016–17), and in approximately 40 technical papers (2024–present) at elliotmcguckenphysics.com. The postulate is not retrofitted to recent data; it *predates* the contemporary precision measurements (LIGO 2015 gravitational-wave detection, modern VLBI light-deflection, modern atom-interferometry de Broglie tests, loophole-free Bell tests of Hensen et al. 2015 and the Big Bell Test 2018) that confirm it.

*(ii) Derivational rigidity of the derivation.* The Algebraic Channel chain (dx₄/dt = ic ⇒ ISO(1,3) ⇒ Stone ⇒ Noether ⇒ Lovelock ⇒ G_μν) and the Geometric Channel chain (dx₄/dt = ic ⇒ McGucken Sphere M^+*p(t) ⇒ Huygens ⇒ area law ⇒ Unruh ⇒ Clausius ⇒ G_μν) have no adjustable parameters between the postulate and the conclusion. There is no fitting; the equations are forced. The empirical predictions (43"/century, 1.75", 2√(2), ℏ c³/(8π G M k_B), 1/4, |ψ|²) are not retrodicted by adjustment; they are *computed* from dx₄/dt = ic and from no other input of comparable specificity.

*(iii) Disjointness as a derivational constraint that cannot be postdicted.* The disjointness of the Algebraic Channel and the Geometric Channel intermediate machinery is a *derivational* feature of the two derivations — a feature one observes after carrying out the derivations, not a feature one fits to data. Were the architecture postdictive, the two channels would presumably share intermediate steps wherever convenient; the observed derivational disjointness is the absence of such sharing across the five cornerstone pairs (Einstein field equations, canonical commutator, Born rule, Tsirelson bound, Hawking temperature). The disjointness *itself* is evidence beyond the channel-existence evidence, contributing the third factor of 10^-47 in Theorem 38.

## 70.5 Implications for the Philosophy of Time

The Bayesian-confirmation result of Theorem 38 grounds the present paper's foundational claims about time at the empirical level, not merely at the level of internal derivational coherence. The five-arrows unification (Theorem 6.7), the Wheeler–DeWitt dissolution (Theorem 24), the active-growing-block recovery (Theorem 36), the Andromeda-paradox dissolution (Theorem 42), and the cosmological-arrow signature (Theorem 33) are *all* theorems of a principle that the dual-channel architecture confirms to a Bayesian likelihood ratio of at least 10¹⁴¹. The philosophy of time built on dx₄/dt = ic is therefore not metaphysical speculation; it is the philosophical content of a principle empirically confirmed by all of foundational gravity and quantum mechanics, derived twice over through derivationally disjoint routes, in the spirit of Newton's *Principia* (where the laws of motion derive the planetary orbits, the tides, and the precession of the equinoxes from a single set of axioms) and Euclid's *Elements* (where the five postulates derive the propositions of geometry through chain-theorem proof).

The McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic — the physical, geometric fact that the fourth dimension is expanding at the velocity of light in a spherically symmetric manner from every spacetime event — *is* the *Principia*-style axiomatic foundation of contemporary physics, with the dual-channel architecture as its *Elements*-style chain-theorem development. The present paper's account of time — its arrows, its asymmetries, its apparent passage, its phenomenology, its cosmological structure, and its resolution of two and a half millennia of philosophical and physical paradoxes — rests on this empirically confirmed foundation.

# 71. Provenance: The McGucken Principle from Princeton 1988 to May 2026

The McGucken Principle dx₄/dt = ic has been under continuous development by the present author since the late 1980s. The trajectory falls into five eras spanning approximately four decades. The trajectory from the Princeton origin to the present paper is documented in detail at [47] and in the corresponding sections of the source-paper corpus.

## 65.1 Era I — The Princeton Origin (late 1980s–1999)

The McGucken Principle was first conceived during the present author's undergraduate work at Princeton University (1988–1993) under John Archibald Wheeler, James Peebles, and Edward Taylor. Wheeler's teaching on the Schwarzschild metric and the EPR paradox — particularly the role of the time-time component g_tt = −(1 − 2GM/(rc²)) in the gravitational time-dilation factor — suggested to the author that the velocity of light c plays a foundational role in spacetime structure that is not exhausted by its appearance in Lorentz transformations or the energy-mass equivalence. The seminal observation was that c is the rate of advance of an underlying fourth dimension; this observation, refined over the undergraduate years and applied to the Compton frequency in 1991–1993, became the proto-form of the McGucken Principle.

The principle was given its first formal articulation in Appendix B of the present author's 1998–1999 doctoral dissertation at the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill ([55]). The Appendix derives, from the assumption dx₄/dt = ic, the geometric content of the Compton frequency mc²/ℏ, the de Broglie relation p = h/λ, and the gravitational time-dilation factor of the Schwarzschild metric. The 1998–1999 priority on the formal physical content of dx₄/dt = ic is documented at the level of an officially deposited doctoral dissertation, accessible through the University of North Carolina's archival system.

Wheeler's recommendation letter for the present author's graduate applications (1993) characterized him as having "more intellectual curiosity, versatility and yen for physics than [Wheeler had] ever seen in any senior or graduate student", and noted his role as Prospero in the Princeton production of Shakespeare's *The Tempest* — a role that has informed the present author's subsequent literary and humanistic engagement with foundational physics.

## 65.2 Era II — Internet Deployments and Usenet (2003–2006)

Following the dissertation, the present author developed and deployed the McGucken Principle on early Internet venues, including a series of detailed posts to Usenet groups sci.physics, sci.physics.relativity, and sci.physics.research in 2003–2006. These posts — archived in the Google Groups Usenet repository — established the principle's public articulation independent of the dissertation's academic-archival channel. The Usenet deployments developed the geometric interpretation of the principle in connection with the Schwarzschild metric, the de Broglie relation, and the Compton frequency.

## 65.3 Era III — FQXi Papers (2008–2013)

In 2008–2013, the present author submitted a series of papers and essays to the Foundational Questions Institute (FQXi) and its essay competitions. The 2008 essay [56] — *Time as an Emergent Phenomenon: Traveling Back to the Heroic Age of Physics (In Memory of John Archibald Wheeler)* — established the formal version of the principle and its derivation of basic physical laws including the Schrödinger equation, Newton's laws, and the Schwarzschild metric. Subsequent FQXi essays (2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013) developed specific implications including the relationship to quantum measurement, the wave-particle duality, the canonical commutation relation, and the derivational foundations of physical law.

## 65.4 Era IV — Books and Consolidation (2016–2017)

In 2016–2017, the present author consolidated the McGucken Principle's development in a series of self-published books: *Light Time Dimension Theory* (2016), *Einstein's Relativity Derived from LTD Theory's Principle* (2017), *Relativity and Quantum Mechanics Unified in Pictures* (2017), *Quantum Entanglement and Einstein's "Spooky Action at a Distance" Explained via LTD Theory's Expanding Fourth Dimension* (2017), and *The Physics of Time: Time & Its Arrows in Quantum Mechanics, Relativity, The Second Law of Thermodynamics, Entropy, The Twin Paradox, & Cosmology Explained via LTD Theory's Expanding Fourth Dimension* (2017). The 2017 book on the physics of time — its title prefiguring the present paper — was the first book-length treatment of the argument that the Second Law, entropy, and the arrows of time all follow from dx₄/dt = ic.

## 65.5 Era V — Continuous Public Development and Active Derivation Program (2017–2026)

Era V comprises the public website *elliotmcguckenphysics.com*, established in 2017 and continuously developed through the present (May 2026). The website hosts a substantial corpus of papers and essays developing specific applications of the McGucken Principle to foundational physics — gravitational, quantum-mechanical, thermodynamic, electroweak, strong-interaction, cosmological, and (in the present paper) philosophical-and-physical foundations of time.

Beginning in October 2024 and continuing through May 2026, the derivational programme intensified into the production of approximately forty technical papers at *elliotmcguckenphysics.com*. These papers establish as theorems of dx₄/dt = ic: the foundational statement of the principle and its six-step proof; the Minkowski metric; the four-momentum operator and the canonical commutation relation [$\hat q$, $\hat p$] = iℏ via two routes; the Schrödinger equation; the Feynman path integral; the Born rule; the Dirac equation with its Clifford structure and spin-½; the general Yang–Mills Lagrangian; the Einstein field equations; the full Noether catalog of conservation laws; the full four-sector Lagrangian $\mathcal{L}_{\text{McG}}$; the de Broglie relation; the Heisenberg uncertainty principle; the McGucken Nonlocality Principle with its Two Laws and the six senses of geometric nonlocality; quantum nonlocality and Bell correlations; the Second Law and arrows of time; the conservation-laws-plus-Second-Law unification; the photon entropy on the McGucken Sphere; the Compton-coupling diffusion empirical signature; the dissolution of the Past Hypothesis; the Bekenstein–Hawking black-hole entropy; the Hawking temperature from the Euclidean cigar geometry; the AdS/CFT GKP–Witten dictionary; Penrose's twistor theory; the Arkani-Hamed–Trnka amplituhedron; Witten's 1995 string-theory dynamics with M-theory unification; and the McGucken Geometry foundational mathematical category.

# Appendix A. Reading the McGucken Principle: A Note on dx₄/dt, dx₄/dτ, and the Photon — Clarifying Common Reader Misconceptions

**About this appendix.** Readers arriving at the McGucken Principle from a standard graduate-relativity background bring one deep habit: the reflex to treat per-proper-time quantities as the "physical" or "covariant" ones, and per-coordinate-time quantities as gauge-dependent bookkeeping. That habit points the wrong way here, because the Principle is a statement about the manifold itself — an expansion happening at every event, at the same rate, regardless of which worldline crosses that event. This appendix explains the four distinct x₄-rate quantities the paper uses, states which one is the Principle, and shows through five worked examples how photons, horizons, twins, and GPS clocks all read naturally once the four quantities are kept in their proper roles.

## A.0 The Physical Fact

Every quantity, rule, and check in this appendix descends from one physical fact:

*The fourth dimension x₄ is expanding in a spherically symmetric manner at the rate of c from every spacetime event, or dx₄/dt = ic.*

That is the McGucken Principle. Before any of its consequences are unpacked, its status must be stated plainly, because it is the point on which every reading in this appendix turns: dx₄/dt = ic is an ontological claim — a statement about what physically is — and not a coordinate convention, a formal device, or a notational choice. It asserts that the fourth dimension is a real dimension that is really expanding, at the rate c, from every event of spacetime, now. The expansion is the physically primary fact; everything else in the paper is a consequence of it. Minkowski spacetime is what the expansion looks like after its rate is integrated into the coordinate x₄ = ict and squared into the Lorentzian metric x₄² = −c²t²; Hilbert space is what the same expansion looks like when its per-increment imaginary rate is read as oscillation; the light cone is the locus the expanding wavefront traces; the metric, the causal order, the Poincaré group, the Born rule, and the Schrödinger equation are all downstream of the one expansion. None of these is postulated independently. They descend, by the derivations of the body, from the single physical fact that x₄ is expanding at c.

This is the reversal the reader must hold onto throughout. Standard physics takes Minkowski spacetime, or the Hilbert space, or the metric, as a starting arena and builds upon it. Here the arena is not a starting point but a result: the starting point is the physical expansion dx₄/dt = ic, and the arena is what that expansion generates. When the appendix below insists that dx₄/dt = ic is primary and the per-proper-time quantities are constructed from it, this is what is meant — not a preference among equivalent formalisms, but a claim about which fact is physically prior. The rate is prior; the worldlines that share in it, the metric that its squaring produces, and the observers that read it are all posterior.

The imaginary unit i in dx₄/dt = ic records the algebraic perpendicularity of the x₄-axis to the three spatial axes on which the expansion casts its projection. Its geometric realisation at each event p is the McGucken Sphere M_p⁺(t) — the spherical wavefront of radius ct swept out around p by the x₄-expansion (§4, Theorem 4). The Sphere is what distinguishes the Principle from Minkowski's constant four-velocity norm u^μu_μ = −c²: the norm is a scalar constraint carrying no group action and no measure, and it survives here as a theorem of the Principle (the chain-rule pullback of the Sphere's expansion rate).

The Sphere carries the geometry that supplies the Born rule downstream: the metric rank of x₄ = ict fixes the exponent as 2 (bilinear pairing of the forward +ic advance with its conjugate −ic advance); the transitive SO(3) action on the round sphere forces a unique invariant probability measure (the round measure dμ = sin θ dθ dφ/(4π), applied over detection directions); the parallelogram identity on the sesquilinear inner product gives the L²-norm structure on Hilbert space; the two-participant physical count of emitter Sphere and absorber Sphere at a coincidence event returns a sesquilinear coincidence rate; and the discrete PT_E-symmetry of the Sphere through its source event gives ψ*(P) = ψ(PT_E · P) exactly. These five properties of the one Sphere agree on P = |ψ|² without sharing premises — five convergent derivations of the Born density from one geometric object (§10 and the master-equation development of §14).

## A.1 The Four x₄-Rate Quantities

The paper uses four related quantities associated with the fourth dimension's advance. Each has its own symbol, its own domain of definition, and its own interpretation, and they diverge on null worldlines.

**(R1) The coordinate rate dx₄/dt = ic.** Parameter: coordinate t; range: fixed value ic; universal — holds at every event. This is the Principle. With the integrated shadow x₄ = ict, this rate holds identically along every worldline — timelike, null, accelerated, at any gravitational potential — because x₄ is a coordinate function of t alone. Every statement about the universality of the expansion, its metric-independence (the rate-rigidity content of §5), or its exception-freeness is a statement in (R1).

**(R2) The Sphere-tangent velocity component v_x₄ ≡ √(c² − v²)** (the worldline's share of the x₄-expansion, per coordinate time); parameter: coordinate t; range: [0, c]; worldline-dependent. A bounded quantity. The partition v² + v_x₄² = c² holds for every worldline, null ones included: at spatial rest v_x₄ = c; on a null worldline v = c gives v_x₄ = 0. On timelike worldlines, v_x₄ coincides with the standard time-dilation-related quantities of special relativity: v_x₄ = c dτ/dt = c/γ for 0 ≤ v < c. The identity v_x₄ = c dτ/dt is a theorem about v_x₄ — τ appears as output, not as the differentiation parameter. At v = c (the null limit) all three expressions give v_x₄ = 0: the √(c² − v²) form by direct substitution, the c dτ/dt form as the ratio c · 0/dt with dτ = 0, and the c/γ form as the limit γ → ∞. The paper uses v_x₄ as the primary symbol because it is defined by direct substitution on the null boundary. Statements about time dilation, the photon's x₄-rest, and horizons live here.

**(R3) The Lorentzian temporal component u⁴ = dx₄/dτ = icγ.** Parameter: proper τ; unbounded, undefined on null worldlines; a chain-rule consequence. Derived from (R1) by the chain rule: dx₄/dτ = (dx₄/dt)(dt/dτ) = icγ. Its magnitude cγ is unbounded as v → c, and on a null worldline (dτ = 0) the quantity is undefined — there the affinely-parametrised null tangent dx^μ/dλ replaces it.

**(R4) The accumulated x₄-advance along γ, X₄[γ] ≡ ∫_γ ic dτ = ic τ[γ].** A worldline functional, path-dependent. Distinct from the coordinate x₄. Two worldlines sharing endpoints share Δx₄ = ic Δt but generally differ in X₄. Along a null worldline X₄ is constant; around any closed curve ∮ dx₄ = 0 identically. Statements about differential ageing (the twins) live in (R4). The bridge to (R2): dX₄ = ic dτ = i v_x₄ dt.

## A.2 Which One Is the Principle

The Principle is dx₄/dt = ic: the coordinate-time reading (R1). Because x₄ is a coordinate function of t alone, the rate dx₄/dt takes the same value ic at every event — an expanding photon-event, a horizon event, an event on any accelerated worldline. The reading dx₄/dτ = ic is available too, but only where dτ = dt: on a worldline at spatial rest, the chain rule collapses and (R1) coincides with the value of (R3). This is the rest-frame reverse-reading equivalence, and the qualification dτ = dt is what makes it valid. On a moving worldline the chain rule gives icγ; on a null worldline the quantity does not exist. The coordinate-time reading is primary because dx₄/dt = ic is a physical fact — the expansion itself is prior to any worldline, and dx₄/dt = ic records it directly.

## A.3 Reading the Photon, the Horizon, and the Time-Dilation Formula

**A.3.1 What is the photon's x₄-rate?** The photon's share in the expansion is zero: v_x₄ = 0 (the v = c limit of v² + v_x₄² = c²), obtained by direct substitution of v = c into v_x₄ = √(c² − v²). The photon is at rest in x₄. The reader may be tempted to write "dx₄/dt = 0 for the photon" or "dx₄/dτ = 0." Neither is available. The first is the coordinate rate (R1), which is ic at every event including the photon's — what vanishes is the photon's share, not the expansion. The second is 0/0: proper time is not defined for a photon (dτ = 0 pointwise). The correct statement is the share v_x₄ = 0, so X₄ does not accumulate, so the photon ages not at all. The Principle continues to hold at every event the photon crosses. This is the four-velocity case of the representation-artifact pattern (Theorem 39.1, §50.4): the proper-time four-velocity u^μ = dx^μ/dτ is 0/0 on the null worldline, and the standard reading takes that degeneracy for the absence of any kinematic state, whereas v_x₄ = 0 and dx₄/dt = ic fix the photon's state at every event it crosses.

**A.3.2 What does "the x₄-rate at the horizon" mean?** The rate is gravity-rigid: ∂(dx₄/dt)/∂g_μν = 0. The rate dx₄/dt = ic takes the same value near the horizon as at infinity. What varies with potential is the share: v_x₄(r) = c dτ/dt = c √(1 − r_s/r) (static Schwarzschild observer), vanishing at r = r_s. On the infaller's own clock dτ = dt locally and the reverse-reading equivalence applies: the local rate is the full ic throughout. Gravitational time dilation is the coordinate-frame projection of a locally invariant rate.

**A.3.3 Which identity is "c² through spacetime"?** Sphere partition (per coordinate time, all worldlines): v² + v_x₄² = c², bounded, locus a quarter-circle. Lorentzian four-velocity norm (per proper time, massive worldlines): u^μ u_μ = |dx₄/dτ|² − |d**x**/dτ|² = −c², unbounded in each term, signature difference fixing the invariant. The Euclidean per-proper-time sum |dx₄/dτ|² + |d**x**/dτ|² equals c² only in the instantaneous rest frame; elsewhere c²γ². Plus-sign identities belong to (R2); minus-sign identities to (R3).

**A.3.4 How does the twin paradox read?** Coordinate accumulation is path-independent: both twins accumulate Δx₄ = ic Δt. Differential ageing is read from X₄ = ∫ ic dτ, advancing at real magnitude v_x₄ per unit coordinate time. On the traveling leg v_x₄ < c, so the traveler accumulates less X₄, so less proper time. The stay-at-home twin retains v_x₄ = c and accumulates the maximal X₄. The CTC question closes the same way: ∮ dx₄ = 0 identically, so a CTC cannot run on the coordinate; the impossibility lives in X₄.

**A.3.5 γ-projection and rapidity.** A boost is hyperbolic: rapidity φ with cosh φ = γ. The Sphere-partition projection is circular: Sphere angle θ with sin θ = v/c, cos θ = v_x₄/c = 1/γ. Related by the Gudermannian, θ = gd(φ), so cos θ = sech φ. The 1/γ projection is about θ; unbounded component growth is about φ.

## A.4 Why Nothing of Relativity Is Lost

The fourth dimension advances at the same rate at every event; worldlines differ only in how much of that advance they share in. Massive at rest shares fully (v_x₄ = c); moving shares less (v_x₄ = √(c² − v²), clock slowed by the Lorentz factor); photon does not share at all (v_x₄ = 0, ageless, no X₄). Lorentz invariance survives entire because the invariant content — the norm u^μu_μ = −c² and the metric — is a theorem of the Principle (the metric is the pullback of the Euclidean form along x₄ = ict, the −c² from (ic)²). Lorentz transformations preserve that derived metric; γ, time dilation, length contraction, E = γmc², the null cone, and the mass-shell all come out unchanged. The foliation quantities v_x₄ and X₄ are additional bookkeeping frame-anchored to the cosmic-comoving foliation (the CMB rest frame); the McGucken Cloaking Theorem (Theorem 39 of §50) explains why local metrology cannot detect them. General relativity survives by the invariant/deformable split within the McGucken dx₄/dt = ic framework: the rate is gravity-rigid; gravity deforms the spatial sector. Time dilation, redshift, light bending, perihelion advance, the horizon, and the field equations are recovered exactly. The horizon is where the share is extinguished; the expansion does not stop.

## A.5 Worked Examples

**A.5.1 The twin paradox.** Traveler at speed v for coordinate time Δt. Coordinate accumulation: Δx₄ = ic Δt for both. Traveler's share: v_x₄ = c √(1 − v²/c²). Accumulated: ΔX₄^trav = ic √(1 − v²/c²) Δt vs ΔX₄^stay = ic Δt. Differential ageing: Δτ_trav − Δτ_stay = Δt(√(1 − v²/c²) − 1) < 0: the traveler is younger by exactly the Lorentz factor.

**A.5.2 GPS clock rate.** Satellite at radius r, speed v, mass M. Principle: dx₄/dt = ic. Gravitational share: v_x₄^grav/c = √(1 − 2GM/rc²); kinematic factor √(1 − v²/c²). Total: v_x₄^sat/c ≈ 1 − GM/(rc²) − v²/(2c²). Ground: ≈ 1 − GM/(R_⊕ c²). Fractional difference ≈ GM(1/R_⊕ − 1/r) − v²/(2c²), matching the +4.5×10⁻¹⁰ pre-launch offset at r = 26,600 km, v = 3.87 km/s.

**A.5.3 Schwarzschild gravitational redshift.** Photon from r₁ to r₂ > r₁. Principle: dx₄/dt = ic. Local clock rate: v_x₄(r)/c = √(1 − r_s/r). Frequency ratio ν₂/ν₁ = √((1 − r_s/r₁)/(1 − r_s/r₂)); weak-field Δν/ν ≈ −GM(1/r₂ − 1/r₁)/c², matching Pound–Rebka 1959. Photon: v_x₄ = 0 throughout, no X₄. The redshift is about the clock rates at emitter and receiver, not the photon.

**A.5.4 Hawking temperature.** At r = r_s, local share v_x₄(r) → 0. Surface gravity κ = c/(2r_s); compactification circumference L_H = 4π r_s = c ℏ β_H; temperature T_H = ℏ c³/(8π G M k_B). The expansion does not stop at the horizon; the share is extinguished on the static foliation, and compactification of the Euclidean-section x₄-axis at L_H produces the thermal spectrum.

**A.5.5 Bell's spaceship.** Rockets A, B at proper distance L₀, accelerating identically. Coordinate rate: dx₄/dt = ic. Share: v_x₄(t) = c √(1 − v(t)²/c²), decreasing. Accumulated: X₄^A = X₄^B, so both age identically. Launch-frame separation constant L₀; co-moving separation L(t) = L₀ c/v_x₄(t), growing without bound. The string breaks: the budget shifts into the spatial sector identically on each rocket, so no differential ageing; the paradox lives in the spatial-sector geometry, the string breaking as co-moving distance grows as 1/v_x₄.
